code.description: Machine-readable refusal code. `stale-id` reports a numeric symbol id or rule index issued by an earlier program: after the loaded project changed on disk, the id must be re-read from a fresh `symbols`/`rules` listing or replaced by the declared name.

event.description: The rule's event binding: a canonical event id, or `subroutine:<name>` for a subroutine rule.

content.description: Present when `content` was requested: the owner's `workshop-rs/rule-content-v1` document. Each condition and action also carries `span` when the program has one.

location.description: Source path and 1-based line/column; full spans are available through findings.

inputIdentity.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the input's primary entry source (the provider's `sourceIdentity` for provider projects). For a single-file input it covers the whole input; for a provider directory project it hashes only the entry file, so member-file edits do not change it — use `stale-id` refusals for freshness, not this value.

unavailable.description: ADR-0024: result members the result should carry but cannot for this input. `names` names the owner that must serve target-language spellings (today `opy-rs` for an OverPy input, until its provider capability exists); raw Workshop results carry no `unavailable`.

returns.description: Optional: the owner-declared return type of a value, in the same vocabulary as parameter types.

variadic.description: Optional: present as true when the callable's last parameter repeats for extra arguments.

written_to.description: The file the program was written to.

input_identity.description: The loaded input's primary entry source digest — same semantics as `project.inputIdentity`.

result_schemas.description: The committed-schema definition describing each advertised operation's result (#532): operation name to its `#/$defs/<Op>Result` reference.

Sources.description: Source name → full current text. On `validateEditTransaction`/`semanticRename` the key is the loaded input's source spelling and the field may be omitted (the service reads the named files from disk, #472). On `providerValidateEdit` the keys are `documents` URIs covering every `edits[].source`; on `providerSemanticRename` they cover every document the provider's computed rename may edit — an edit into an unsupplied source refuses `edit-unknown-source`. The text is the precondition each edit's `source_identity` verifies against and the text edits apply to.

EditRange.description: A half-open source range in 1-based lines and character columns; `end` is exclusive and a column may point one past the line's last character. A zero-width range inserts `new_text`.

kind.description: The edit kind: `edit` for a caller-proposed replacement; other kinds such as `rename` appear only on service-computed results.

source.description: The source this edit applies to: the loaded input's spelling on `validateEditTransaction`, or a `documents` URI key on the provider operations.

source_identity.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the source's current text — the same digest `project.inputIdentity` reports for the entry source; a text that hashes differently refuses `edit-stale-source`.

new_text.description: The replacement text; empty deletes the range.

edits.description: The transaction's edits, applied atomically; edits in one source must not overlap, and two zero-width edits at the same position refuse `edit-zero-width-conflict`.

symbol.description: Symbol addressing (#434): the numeric symbol id or the declared name, exactly as `references`/`usage` address symbols. When present, `source`/`line`/`col` are ignored. A numeric id issued before a disk reload is refused `stale-id` until a `symbols` listing re-establishes the space.

source.description: Position addressing: the source file the position is interpreted in; requires `line` and `col`.

line.description: Position addressing: the 1-based line of a character inside one identifier occurrence.

col.description: Position addressing: the 1-based column of a character inside one identifier occurrence.

uri.description: The document's URI — also its key in `documents`; provider edit results address documents by it.

version.description: The document's current version; provider-computed edits validated against another version refuse `edit-stale-source`.

DocumentSet.description: URI → `Document` map: the caller-owned project document set the provider operates on. `providerValidateEdit` refuses an `edits[].source` outside the set with `edit-unknown-source`; `providerSemanticRename` requires `position_document_uri` inside the set and refuses provider-returned edits outside it with `provider-edit-outside-set`.

Position.description: A 0-based line and UTF-16 character offset — the provider convention, unlike `EditRange`'s 1-based columns.

output.description: File to write the program to; default `<entry stem>.ow` in the service's working directory.

force.description: Replace an existing output file. The service never prompts, so a repeat compile to the same file needs force: true. The input source file is never overwritten.

to.description: Output locale for the emitted Workshop text (e.g. "en-US", "zh-CN"); defaults to the loaded input's locale. Use it to convert Workshop text between client locales independently of the input locale.

rule.description: A declared rule name selects that rule's element-cost drill-down (#724): `rule` (identity, count, span), `statements[]` (direct children ranked by recursive count) and `byNode[]` (each node's own contribution summed per canonical node name, with occurrences) replace the whole-program `elementCount`/`findings` view. The drill-down reports no findings, so `severity`/`file`/`max` do not apply to it.

language_id.description: The configured source provider's language id — `opy` for the shipped provider.

documents.description: Optional: the caller-owned document set — must contain `position_document_uri`, the project entry document (the provider resolves the analyzable view from a supplied entry — a member file alone can refuse `rename.noSymbolAtPosition`), and every document the rename may edit. Omitted or null: the session's loaded project supplies the set — every member read from disk at version 0, keyed by `file://` URI.

position_document_uri.description: URI of the `documents` document holding the rename position.

project_root.description: Optional project root the provider resolves the project from.

documents.description: Optional: the caller-owned document set — every `edits[].source` must be a key, and errors in any supplied document block the post-edit check. Omitted or null: the session's loaded project supplies the set — every member read from disk at version 0, keyed by `file://` URI.
